theDefect.rootCause: addedPaintedPaths(sourceBytes, artifactBytes) asked what the finished artifact carries that the RAW source did not. For a protected text blank that is the right question; for a protected BUTTON it is not. The raw source keeps its radios and checkboxes as live widgets whose blank /Off face lives in an /AP appearance stream rather than in page content. The host's own normalization -- delete /V and /DV, force every button widget to /AS /Off, then flatten -- MOVES that untouched blank face into the page content, where a raw-source diff reads it as newly painted. The 25 reported paths were the control's own empty box and its hairlines.
theDefect.bisectConfirmed: FABLE-R11 established, and this lane did not contradict, that the family was un-rebuildable across both east-host states, so the recent host change did not cause it.

whatChangedInTheHelper.shape: A change of BASELINE inside the existing protection helper, not a change of rule, and not a new renderer, registry or framework.
changes: zeroWriteNormalizedBaseline(): new. Carries the same source through the same finalizeEastOfficialForm with facts {}, explicitMappings {}, exactFieldMap [] and every census field listed unwritable, asserts the result wrote nothing, and caches by source sha so one baseline serves both fixtures of a document.

finalizeEastOfficialForm() now also returns preparedSourceBytes -- the neutralized, not-yet-flattened bytes -- because conditions 2 and 3 are about the state that goes INTO the flatten and must be read from those bytes rather than from a report about them.
choiceStateOfBytes(): new. Reads /V and every widget /AS straight from the PDF objects.

focusedRegionIsIdentical(): new. Condition 6. Rasters one page of the artifact and one page of the baseline at 288 DPI, crops the widget rectangle with a one-pixel margin (converting bottom-left PDF space to top-left raster space through the measured page geometry), and compares greyscale pixels.
rasterizePdf() gained an optional dpi, defaulting to the inventoried RASTER_DPI and asserted to be non-standard only for a single focused diagnostic page. Every inventoried raster is unchanged.

evaluateProtectedFieldInk(): the protected loop, lifted out of proofFromArtifact and EXPORTED so its control drives the real gate rather than a copy of it. Behaviour for a protected field with no raw-source paths is unchanged. For a protected field that does show raw-source paths, the gate now computes the paths BEYOND the zero-write baseline and excuses the field only when all six conditions hold; every failure path records a named reason and the field still fails.

proofFromArtifact() takes preFlattenBytes and an async normalizedBaseline thunk, and publishes protectedSourceOwnedAppearances alongside the unchanged protectedInk and protectedVectorInk. The thunk is called only when a protected widget actually shows raw-source paths, so the fourteen other families pay nothing for a second finalization.
whatChangedInTheHelper.whyThisShape: The decision's preferred implementation exactly: measure a zero-write source-normalized flattened baseline, compare protected-field appearances against it rather than against raw source page content, and treat only paths beyond it as artifact-added. It consults no family name and no field name; the excuse is earned by six proofs about the widget itself, and any protected field that fails any one of them still fails the gate.

beforeAndAfterCompleteness.oneTrapWorthRecording: The FIRST reproduction run destroyed the family's own carried classifications. buildOfficial() reads the prior production-field-map.json for installed classifications and only THEN calls resetOwnedOutput(), which rm -rf's the directory. When the base run aborted on the protected-field assertion, the reset had already happened and the map was gone, so the next build classified from scratch and lost the installed 'signature_or_date_participant_completion' on the notice-certification field 'notified of this motion and the court date is at least ten 10 days prior to the hearing date'. Rederived, it became a bare required-before-filing declaration on a field whose captured label reads 'the Office of the Attorney ', which the completeness contract correctly refuses as an ATTORNEY_BLOCK field, giving FAIL_MISSING_PREFILLS at unclassifiedBlanks 1. The fix was not to reclassify anything: the committed family output was restored from HEAD and rebuilt once so the carry-forward ran as designed. The committed map's classifications are intact in the rebuilt map. No family classification was invented or hand-edited.

buildOfficial() resets a family's output directory before it can finish, so an aborted build silently discards the installed completeness classifications the next build depends on carrying forward. This is what turned one failed reproduction run into a FAIL_MISSING_PREFILLS. Recorded as an observation about the host's ordering; not repaired, because repairing it is not this lane's grant.
